results.note: SD-33 remediation wave 6 (sd33-r6-corpus-extraction): the corpus-extraction gap this unit was originally escalated for is FIXED -- data/corpus/advanced_race_guide/equipment/rending_claw_blades.json's raw_tokens now carries the .MOD-attached EQMOD reference ('EQMOD: Special Ability ~ Keen ~ Weapon.Special Ability ~ +1 ~ Weapon.Material ~ Steel'), src/bin/enrich_equipment_raw_tokens.rs now folds in a <record_key>.MOD row wherever it appears in the cited LST file, not just a .COPY= base. CONFIRMED STILL disagree, ours=0, because a SEPARATE, narrower defect remains: compute_equipment_effects's weapon path (src/rules_core/equipment_effects.rs, around 'let weapon_enhancement_bonus = equipmods::compute_equipmods_effect(record);') only reads the resolved item's OWN bonus_chains -- it never resolves the item's EQMOD:-referenced modifier records and sums THEIR compute_equipmods_effect result in, unlike resolve_category_effect's already-shipped AC path (arms_armor::apply_eqmod_armor_class_bonus + eqmod_referenced_records, wave 4, commit abc72f75ec). Proven live this cycle: a scratch integration test (compute_equipment_effects against the real, now-fixed on-disk corpus record, single equipped selection, no fixture) prints 'weapon_enhancement_bonus = Some(WeaponEnhancementBonus { tohit_bonus: Some(1), damage_bonus: None, ... })' -- tohit_bonus matches the oracle's own MAGICHIT=+1 exactly (unchanged, always agreed), damage_bonus stays None because the '+1 ~ Weapon'/'Keen' EQMOD-referenced records' own BONUS:WEAPON|DAMAGE,TOHIT|1|TYPE=Enhancement chain is never summed in. Fix design (not implemented this cycle -- out of this lane's granted write scope, src/rules_core/ with 4 sibling lanes concurrently running): widen the weapon_enhancement_bonus assembly in compute_equipment_effects to also fold in eqmod_referenced_records(record, RuleSetId::Crb, corpus).iter().map(equipmods::compute_equipmods_effect), merging tohit_bonus/damage_bonus by Option-sum, matching the AC path's already-proven pattern. This is a small, well-precedented, one-cycle fix, not a new large blocker.
